nodes.body: <<FILL role=setup words=110 beats='{HEROES} find {THRESHOLD} locked, with a coded note pinned to the door; establish the {CIPHER} mystery and the friends'>>
<<FILL role=choice words=70 beats='the {HEROES} read the note through twice and split on what to try first'>>

choices.label: Examine the {CIPHER} note pinned to the door.
Search the building for another way in.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=rising words=175 beats='The note is a substitution {CIPHER}; decoding the first line reveals a hint about a hidden key and {ACCESS_LOW}'>>

choices.label: Follow the clue to hunt for the hidden key.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=rising words=175 beats='A stiff side door and {ACCESS_HIGH} offer two ways in; mild tension, nothing dangerous'>>

choices.label: Shoulder the stiff side door open.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=rising words=175 beats='Gruff but kind, {KEEPER} warns the tower is tricky; offers to let them in, or to tell who built the {CIPHER}'>>
<<FILL role=rising words=175 beats='Searching the steps, the friends turn up {KEY} under a loose brick, exactly where the decoded clue pointed'>>
<<FILL role=rising words=175 beats='Here {KEEPER} explains that {MAKER} hid a secret in the tower decades ago; useful background that makes later clues clearer'>>

choices.label: Head inside with what you have learned.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=rising words=175 beats='Squeezing through {ACCESS_HIGH} is a small thrill; they drop safely onto a landing inside the tower'>>
<<FILL role=choice words=175 beats='Bottleneck: inside the dim tower with a spiral stair, {STUDY}, {HAZARD}, and a dark basement; four ways onward'>>
<<FILL role=rising words=175 beats='The spiral stair climbs toward {LANDMARK_FACE}; a loose step hides {TOKEN} they can pocket'>>
<<FILL role=rising words=175 beats='Inside, {STUDY} holds {CIPHER_TOOL} that explains the code, plus stacks of tempting old {ARCHIVE}'>>
<<FILL role=rising words=175 beats='A narrow ledge runs past {HAZARD}; {LUBRICANT} sits at the far end; mild peril, a careful crossing'>>

choices.label: Decide the ledge is too risky and back out.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=rising words=175 beats='The basement holds {MACHINERY} and a service ladder that rises straight to {LANDMARK_FACE}'>>

choices.label: Take the service ladder up to {LANDMARK_FACE}.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=choice words=175 beats='Bottleneck: {LANDMARK_FACE}; the {CIPHER} must be set onto the hands; options to set it correctly, force it, search a back panel, or try random settings'>>

choices.label: Search for a back panel behind {LANDMARK_FACE}.
Spin the hands at random and hope.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=climax words=175 beats='Setting the {CIPHER} time exactly, gears click and a hidden panel slides open to reveal {VAULT}; a triumphant beat'>>
<<FILL role=climax words=175 beats='Forcing the hands jams the gears with a screech; with {LUBRICANT} they can free it, otherwise it stays stuck'>>

choices.label: Give up; the gears will not move.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=rising words=175 beats='Behind {LANDMARK_FACE} is a second tiny {CIPHER} panel; solving it opens {VAULT}, or reveals {SECRET_ROOM} instead'>>
<<FILL role=choice words=175 beats='Bottleneck: {VAULT} holds {MAKER}s letter, {KEEPSAKE}, and a small treasure; choose how to handle the secret'>>

choices.label: Decode the final message and bring it to {SETTLEMENT}.
Stuff the treasure in your bag and run.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=failure words=160 beats='Lost in the {ARCHIVE}, the friends look up to find the tower closing for the night; they leave clever but empty-handed, free to return; non-death, gentle'>>
<<FILL role=failure words=160 beats='Backing away from {HAZARD}, they decide some risks are not worth it; they go home safe, the {CIPHER} unsolved for now; non-death'>>
<<FILL role=failure words=160 beats='Random settings jam the whole mechanism; {CLOSING_SIGN} ring and they must leave; the tower keeps its secret; non-death, a learning beat'>>
<<FILL role=failure words=160 beats='The forced gears stay jammed; the friends leave for the night, planning to come back with the right tools; non-death'>>
<<FILL role=completion words=170 beats='Beyond the panel, {SECRET_ROOM} is a wonder of half-finished {CRAFT}; they become its quiet keepers; a warm, satisfying discovery'>>

<<FILL role=completion words=170 beats='The decoded message restores something lost to {SETTLEMENT}; the friends are quiet heroes and the {MECHANISM} runs true again; the main triumphant, series-advancing ending'>>
<<FILL role=completion words=170 beats='They keep the secret among themselves, a bond that is theirs alone; a happy, private ending'>>
<<FILL role=failure words=160 beats='Grabbing the treasure springs a harmless cage of jingling bells; {KEEPER} finds them and they sheepishly put it all back; comic, non-death failure'>>
